name: @sce/sdk
description: TypeScript client for the Self-Consistency Answer Engine API

scripts.build: bun run build:js && bun run build:types
scripts.build:js: bun build src/index.ts --outdir dist --target node --format esm --external zod && bun build src/index.ts --outdir dist/browser --target browser --format esm --external zod && bun build src/index.ts --outdir dist/bun --target bun --format esm --external zod
scripts.build:types: bunx tsc -p tsconfig.build.json && bun run scripts/declarations.ts
